16. Pre-Note: Update JPMC SFTP to Non-PROD or Disable Delivery
Procedure
Navigate to My Client Groups.
Open Data Exchange.
Open Extract Definitions.
Enable Show Filters.
Search the required extract definitions under US Legislative Data Group.
Open the extract definition.
In the left-side navigation panel, click Deliver.
Locate the prenote delivery option.
Delete the highlighted prenote delivery entry.
Click Validate.
Click Done.
Expected Results
Task completes successfully without Oracle validation or save errors.
